original_bug_mechanism: The search misses the final candidate and lacks the empty-needle special case.
synthetic_bug_mechanism: Partial-match state is initialized once instead of once per candidate. A failed prefix can make a later nonmatching region appear to match.
distinctness: The original upstream fix is retained. Partial-match state is initialized once instead of once per candidate. A failed prefix can make a later nonmatching region appear to match.
oracle: Searching four bytes abXc for two bytes ac must return NULL. All original memmem assertions must still pass.
realism: A loop-invariant-code-motion optimization incorrectly treats per-candidate state as invariant.
test_changes: Minimal additions to the existing regression suite; original tests and assertions preserved.
